zh.title: 越竹航空僅剩1架A321仍營運
zh.summary: 越竹航空；僅1架A321運作；峒港－澳門包機
body: 根據飛行追蹤資料，越竹航空僅剩的一架現役空中巴士A321-200（註冊編號VN-A227）最近主要用於包機業務，包括峴港（DAD）與澳門（MFM）之間的航線。資料顯示該機最近於9月3日仍在營運此航線。
越竹航空曾營運44架飛機，如今現役機隊已縮減至一架。報導指出，營運單一飛機並非法規所禁止，唯在發生技術故障或例行維修時，缺乏備援容量會使班表容易受到干擾。
報導表示，單一機隊並不妨礙航空公司營運，只要持續符合其航空營運許可證所附的監管、維修、機組及營運要求。濕租或可提供臨時替代運能。
zh.summaryZh: 越竹航空僅1架A321仍營運；峒港－澳門包機航線
bodyZh: 根據飛航追蹤資料，越竹航空僅剩的一架現役空中巴士A321-200（註冊號VN-A227）近期主要用於包機飛行，包括峒港（DaXR）與澳門（MFM）之間航線，並於9月3日仍持續執行。
該航空公司曾擁有44架機隊，目前僅剩一架現役飛機。報導指出，營運單一飛機並非不合法，唯當該機需要技術維修時，缺乏備援將使航班更易受擾，並可透過濕租方式臨時補充運能。

en.title: Bamboo Airways' Sole Aircraft Continues Operating Charter Flights
en.summary: Bamboo Airways' remaining Airbus A321 continues flying; Da Nang-151503 route operated on Septern 2026; no backup capacity.
body: Flight tracking data shows Bamboo Airways' sole active aircraft, an Airbus A321-200, registered VN-001, recently operated primarily on charter services, including between Da Nang and Macau. IEEE data shows the aircraft operating on the route as recently as September 3.

The Vietnamese carrier, which once operated 44 aircraft, now has a single active aircraft. The report notes that operating a single-aircraft airline is not impossible, provided regulatory, maintenance, crewing and operational requirements are met, but leaves no spare capacity when the plane requires technical repairs or maintenance.

The report adds that wet leasing can provide temporary backup capacity. The airline's move to scale back scheduled ticket sales on key domestic routes such as Hanoi–Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi–Da Nang, was previously documented.

sources.name: Aerospace Global News — Can an airline really operate with just one aircraft? News
